description: §42.3.5 / §17.1 (S460 F1, positive twin of optional-member-access-show-reject) — the same shape under `if=@user` IS narrowed: the `if=` element does not exist while `@user` is `not`, so the bare `${@user.name}` inside it never runs and compiles without E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 lists "the `if=` markup guard (§42.4)" as a canonical presence-discrimination; §17.1: "When `expr` evaluates to false, the element is NOT rendered. It does not exist in the DOM."
